messages:
Maria C: taking the handoff now - primary is me until 0200 UTC, Liam you are secondary. quick heads-up: one customer reported elevated 95th latency for embeddings at ~01:30 UTC.
Liam K: copy, I'm on pager standby. any idea scope?
Maria C: initial check shows spike from us-east-1 inference pool, KV cache miss rate spiked. telemetry: embeddings pipeline QPS normal but p95 tokens up ~2.3x.
Jun S: @Maria C did the incident bot tag anything?
oncall-bot: [incident] 1769801240 - High p95 latency - embeddings-us-east - severity: medium - affected: subset of requests - runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache
Rahul P: if it's KV miss storm we have two quick mitigations: 1) increase KV cache size on inference nodes (hotfix), 2) route traffic to dedicated spare pool. both low-risk.
Maria C: linking runbooks & quick commands below. prioritize routing first if customers impacted. Customer impact: A few enterprise customers seeing regen failures on batch jobs; not widespread. see impact checklist.
Liam K: ok will prep routing. Maria, can you post the runbook link?
Maria C: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-regen 
Maria C: quick routing command (gateway):
```
redwood route update --from embeddings-us-east --to embeddings-spare-us-east --percent 40 --policy gradual
```
Maria C: kubectl restart for inference-service (if we need redeploy):
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-service-us-east
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-service-us-east --replicas=0 && kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-service-us-east --replicas=4
```
Jun S: note: restarting clears local KV entries; use only if stuck. eviction command (force re-populate):
```
curl -X POST https://inference-us-east.internal/admin/kv/evict?prefix=embed:
```
Rahul P: checklist for this handoff:
- mark primary/secondary in channel
- run quick impact assessment: customers affected, duration, SLAs at risk
- apply routing -> monitor p95 & error rates for 5 minutes
- if no improvement, restart small subset of nodes (canary 2)
- notify sales/customer success if any enterprise jobs delayed > 10m
Maria C: Customer impact snippet to paste to CS: 
"We've identified elevated embedding latency from the us-east inference pool affecting some batch jobs. We're routing traffic to spare capacity and applying cache mitigations; expected resolution within 15-25 minutes. We'll update with progress every 10 minutes."
Liam K: starting routing now to spare pool at 40% (gradual). will post metrics in 2 mins. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: [action] 1769801300 - routing policy change requested by Liam K - gradual 40% - tooling runbook: https://internal.redwood/tools/routing-playbook
Maria C: watching dashboards - p95 trending down already to ~1.4x baseline. good sign. keep gradual for 5 mins then bump if stable.
Liam K: dashboards show error rate stable, kv miss rate down 30%. bumping to 60% now.
Rahul P: if we need to avoid restarts, we can increase in-memory cache cap on nodes via feature flag until tomorrow:
```
redwood infra set-flag --service inference --flag kv_cache_max_mb=1024
```
Jun S: small reminder for handoff later: please include which runbook step you did (routing/evict/restart) and current metrics snapshot and any customer pings completed.
Maria C: agreed. I'll set a pinned summary before handback: actions taken, time, metrics link, CS message copy.
Liam K: once Maria pins it I can take over at 0200 UTC. I'm ready to escalate to dedicated if we see regression.
Maria C: pinned summary: actions - routing 40->60%, eviction POST called, monitored p95 down to baseline+10%, CS notified. next: monitor for 30m then close.
oncall-bot: [note] 1769801575 - handoff summary pinned by Maria C
Rahul P: final quick remediations (cheatlist):
- Route to spare pool (gradual)
- Evict KV prefix for embeddings
- Increase kv_cache_max_mb flag temporarily
- Canary restart if nodes unresponsive
- Notify CS with templated impact note
Jun S: thanks team. leaving the thread for the handoff doc now. primary/secondary clear in case of rebound.
Maria C: handing off to Liam K at 0200 UTC. all alerts shared, pager ownership transferred. :white_check_mark:
